# ui::CheckedField

Header: `winui/core/Property.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::Binding< std::optional< bool > >`.

The type of a check box's `checked` ([CheckBox](../controls/check-box.md#uicheckbox), [ToggleButton](../controls/toggle-button.md#uitogglebutton), [AppBarToggleButton](../controls/app-bar-button.md#uiappbartogglebutton)): true, false or std::nullopt for indeterminate. It is a [`Binding<std::optional<bool>>`](binding.md) that also takes a writable [`Property<bool>`](property.md) two-way, since a click only ever produces true or false: the property gets each click, and an indeterminate state the app sets on the control writes nothing. A [`Property<std::optional<bool>>`](property.md) is two-way as everywhere else, and is the one to bind when a click can reach indeterminate (the spec's `three_state`).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool>                agreed{false};
ui::Property<std::optional<bool>> all{false}; // std::nullopt while only some items are on
ui::CheckBox{.text = "I agree", .checked = agreed};     // two-way, two states
ui::CheckBox{.text = "Select all", .checked = all};     // two-way, shows mixed
```

## CheckedField

```cpp
CheckedField() = default
```

Unchecked.

## CheckedField

```cpp
CheckedField(Binding<std::optional<bool>> binding)
```

Any binding of the field's own type: a constant, [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) or [bind_one_way()](namespace-ui.md#bind_one_way).

## CheckedField

```cpp
CheckedField(Property<bool>& source)
```

A writable [`Property<bool>`](property.md), two-way: the same as [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) of it.

## CheckedField

```cpp
CheckedField(TwoWayBinding<bool> two_way)
```

A two-way binding of a bool ([bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) of a [`Property<bool>`](property.md), [ui::selects()](namespace-ui.md#selects)): the control follows it, and a click writes true or false back. An indeterminate state is never written.

## writes_bool

```cpp
bool writes_bool() const noexcept
```

True when a click writes into a [`Property<bool>`](property.md), which cannot hold indeterminate.

## selection_group

```cpp
const void* selection_group() const noexcept
```

The group of choices it came from, for a binding made by [ui::selects()](namespace-ui.md#selects); nullptr otherwise.
